tutorial.race: Hokm **does not play out all thirteen tricks**. The moment one partnership takes **seven**, the hand is over and the rest of the cards are never played. The figures above are that race.
tutorial.hakem: The **hakem** declares trump from their **first five cards only** — not from a full hand, which is what makes it a gamble. **The hakem keeps the role while their team keeps winning.**
tutorial.kot: Taking the hand scores 1, and **letting the other side take no trick at all is a Kot, worth 2**. Stacking Kots while holding on to the hakem's role is the fastest way home.
tutorial.hand: Your hand. Legal cards get a green ring. When your partner (T0) is winning a trick, keep your high cards back.
